在修真界，有灵根的弟子不是修真世家的，就是各大门派自产自销，所有想要增加弟子，只能去凡俗世界。

缥缈宗每三年就会派弟子去凡俗界，寻找有灵根的弟子。

每年浩浩荡荡的去一大波人，但是十个人不一定带得回来一个人，由此可见，凡俗界有灵根，能修仙的人是何其的少。

既然这么少，为什么这些宗门还乐此不疲的往凡俗界跑呢？

那是因为，许多扬名修真界，甚至是飞升的大能，半数都是出自凡俗界。

没人知道为什么灵气不足的凡俗界，为何成了天才诞生的摇篮。

所以就算去一次什么都捞不到，各大宗门还是愿意往凡俗界跑，不但能让弟子历练，说不定还能捡到下一任扬名立万的大能。

作为看过无数小黄文……呸，修真文的资深读者，时笙只想说……

这都是套路！

主角身世必须惨，死爹死娘死全家，族人陷害，掉入悬崖，遇见老爷爷，得到奇怪传承，从此踏上修仙路，打怪升级，打脸酸爽。

所以凡俗界出天才……

都特么的是为了打脸啊！

老子从凡俗界来的，也能干翻你们这群自诩出身高人一等，优越感爆棚的人。

是不是很牛逼？是不是很带感？

时笙一眼就从人群中看到了叶清秋——尼玛，站得那么高，不想看到都难。

她站在宗主后面，摆着高冷女神范儿，那睥睨的姿态，好像下面站的都是一群蝼蚁。

时笙：“……”为什么本宝宝解读出了这么诡异信息？

叶清秋似乎察觉到时笙的视线，往她这边看了一眼，那不屑的眼神，让时笙差点没跳起来。

我类个去，这女主有点不对劲！

这个时候，女主应该还没崩才对啊！

“商殊师叔。”身边突然响起一道清脆的女声，打断了时笙观察叶清秋的视线。

时笙扭头看了那个少女几秒，“楚凝？”

楚凝旁边还站在一个男人，身上穿的也是深蓝色的道袍，看上去很阳光，看她的眼神有些厌恶。

这是楚夜了？楚凝的哥哥。

原主曾经喜欢的那个男人。

啧啧……

和玉箫比起来，简直是一个天上，一个地上。

商殊这妹纸，果然是傻！

“师叔也要去吗？”楚凝眼底有些敌意和防备。

“嗯。”时笙随意的点了点头，往白琅那边看去，“师兄叫我了，我先过去了。”

In the world of cultivation, disciples with spiritual roots are either from the cultivation family or from various sects who produce and sell their own products. Anyone who wants to increase his disciples can only go to the mortal world.

Every three years, the Piaomiao Sect sends disciples to the mortal world to look for disciples with spiritual roots.

A large number of people go there every year, but ten people may not be able to bring back one person. This shows that there are very few people in the mortal world who have spiritual roots and can cultivate immortality.

Since there are so few, why do these sects still happily run to the mortal world?

That's because half of the great powers who are famous in the world of cultivation, or even ascended, come from the mortal world.

No one knows why the secular world, which lacks spiritual energy, has become the cradle of geniuses.

Therefore, even if they can't get anything from one trip, major sects are still willing to go to the mortal world. Not only can their disciples gain experience, but they may also be able to pick up the next great master who will become famous.

As an experienced reader who has read countless pornographic articles... bah, cultivation articles, Shi Sheng just wants to say...

This is all a routine!

The protagonist's life experience must be tragic. His father died, his mother died, his whole family died, his clan members framed him, he fell off a cliff, met an old man, received a strange inheritance, and then embarked on the path of cultivating immortality, fighting monsters and upgrading, which was a sour face.

So geniuses emerge from the world of mortals...

It’s all just to slap you in the face!

Even though I came from the mortal world, I can defeat you people who claim to be superior to others and have a strong sense of superiority.

Isn’t it awesome?Isn’t it very touching?

Shi Sheng saw Ye Qingqiu from the crowd at a glance - Nima, standing so high, it was hard not to miss him.

She stood behind the sect master, looking like a cold goddess, with a stern attitude, as if there were a swarm of ants standing below her.

Shi Sheng: "..." Why did this baby interpret such strange information?

Ye Qingqiu seemed to be aware of Shi Sheng's gaze and glanced in her direction. His disdainful look made Shi Sheng almost jump.

Let me tell you, there is something wrong with this heroine!

At this time, the heroine should not have collapsed yet!

"Uncle Shang Shu." A clear female voice suddenly sounded beside him, interrupting Shi Sheng's observation of Ye Qingqiu.

Shi Sheng turned to look at the girl for a few seconds, "Chu Ning?"

There was a man standing next to Chu Ning. He was also wearing a dark blue robe. He looked very sunny and looked at her with disgust.

Is this Chu Ye?Chu Ning's brother.

The man the original owner once liked.

Tsk tsk...

Compared with Yuxiao, it is like heaven and earth.

This girl Shang Shu is really stupid!

"Uncle Master, are you going too?" Chu Ning's eyes were somewhat hostile and defensive.

"Yes." Shi Sheng nodded casually and looked towards Bai Lang, "Senior brother called me, I'll go over first."
